prefLabel: Reproject a raster onto a regular grid
definition: Reprojects a raster onto a regular grid covering a bounding box.

assumedFormatGaps.name: band_file
assumedFormatGaps.reason: The CWL (GeoLabs/KindGrove v0.0.2-rc2, `reproject_band`) declares no `format` on this File, so the processDescription derived by eoap.cct.cwl-to-ogcprocess serves application/octet-stream: the deployment exposes no media type for the GeoTIFF it reads and writes. Closed upstream if the CWL declares `format: ogc:geotiff`.
assumedFormatGaps.evidence: Run record `kindgrove-steps` (scripts/sources.yaml): the three band_file inputs (red.tif, green.tif, nir.tif) and the three reprojected_file outputs (red_4326.tif, green_4326.tif, nir_4326.tif) start with the TIFF magic number 49 49 2a 00 (observed 2026-11-09); GeoTIFF tags not checked.

openeoEquivalence.rationale: resample_spatial with a target `resolution` and `projection` (epsg); no explicit resampling-method parameter in the CWL (implementation default), same partial match as `algae-bloom.reproject-image`.
